headline: Atmospheric Rivers and Gale-Force Winds Lash the Pacific Northwest as a Multi-Day Sierra Nevada Winter Storm Intensifies
overview: A powerful series of atmospheric rivers is driving gale-force winds, widespread flooding, and heavy mountain snowfall across the Pacific Northwest and Sierra Nevada through the weekend. On the other side of the globe, Solomon Islands aftershocks continue following this week's M6.4 earthquake, and New Delhi's smog crisis persists with AQI values in the 'very poor' range for a fourth consecutive day. Mayon Volcano in the Philippines issued a fresh ash advisory on November 12, underscoring ongoing geological unrest across the Pacific Rim.

events.title: Pacific Northwest 'Gales of November' — Atmospheric Rivers Bring High Winds, Floods, and Mountain Snow
events.location: Oregon, Washington, and British Columbia, Pacific Northwest
events.summary: A conveyor belt of storms driven by atmospheric rivers is delivering damaging high winds — with gusts up to 65–70 mph along the Oregon and Siskiyou coasts — combined with heavy rainfall, flood watches in Mason County, Washington, and significant mountain snow into British Columbia. NWS Medford issued High Wind Warnings for the South Central Oregon Coast and Central Siskiyou County through Friday morning, warning of downed trees, widespread power outages, and difficult travel on Highway 101 and Interstate 5. Forecasters note 3–4.5 inches of rain are expected in some Washington valleys through Saturday, raising river flooding risk across the region.

articles.title: Atmospheric rivers to bring flood risk, strong winds to Northwest and heavy snow to British Columbia
The "Gales of November" have arrived in the Pacific Northwest

events.title: Sierra Nevada Winter Storm Escalates — Up to 20 Inches at Crest, 70–90 MPH Ridge Gusts
events.location: Sierra Nevada, California and Nevada, USA
events.summary: What was a Watch on November 11 has escalated into a broad Winter Storm Warning stretching from the Northern Sierra through the Lake Tahoe area, Yosemite, Sequoia, Kings Canyon, and Mono County, active from Friday afternoon through Tuesday morning. Snow accumulations are forecast at up to 20 inches along the Lake Tahoe crest, with ridgetop wind gusts of 70–90 mph and 35–55 mph winds in Truckee and Lake Tahoe communities — conditions expected to severely disrupt Interstate 80, Highway 50, and Friday evening and Monday morning commutes. The storm arrives just days before several Sierra resorts are set to open for the ski season, bringing the first significant snowpack of the winter.

events.title: Solomon Islands M6.4 Earthquake — Shallow Strike, Ongoing Aftershocks
events.summary: A magnitude 6.4 earthquake struck 30 km west-southwest of Lata in the Solomon Islands on November 9 at a shallow depth of just 17 km, increasing its potential for surface impact across the island chain. USGS assigned a green alert level and no Pacific-wide tsunami warning was issued, though the shallow depth and remote location limited felt reports to two. Aftershock activity has continued, with a M5.2 recorded on November 10 near the same epicentral area, keeping the seismic sequence active.

events.title: St. Johns River Rises to Major Flood Stage — Cocoa to Crest at 17.2 Feet by Saturday
events.location: Brevard, Seminole, Lake, and Volusia Counties, Florida, USA
events.summary: The St. Johns River near Cocoa has risen into Major flood stage and is forecast to crest at 17.2 feet by early Saturday morning, November 14, remaining elevated through at least Sunday night — a level that rivals historic flooding from Tropical Storm Fay. Flood Warnings remain in effect across Brevard, Seminole, Volusia, and Lake counties, with additional gauges near Sanford and DeLand forecast to enter Minor flood stage by Friday as the river continues its slow northward rise. Residents in affected Cocoa and Rockledge neighborhoods have been urged to monitor Brevard County emergency alerts.

events.title: New Delhi Smog Crisis — AQI Climbs Again to 323, 'Very Poor' for Fourth Consecutive Day
events.summary: New Delhi's air quality index rose to 323 on November 12, sustaining the 'very poor' category for a fourth straight day following the post-Diwali pollution surge that pushed AQI above 400. Stagnant surface winds of just 5.4 km/h are preventing dispersion of pollutants from farm fires in Punjab and Haryana, vehicle emissions, and construction dust. India Today reports that AQI remained above 400 overnight into November 12, with health authorities continuing to advise residents — especially children and the elderly — to limit outdoor exposure.

events.title: Mayon Volcano — New Eruption and Ash Advisory Issued November 12, Alert Level 3 Maintained
events.summary: Mayon Volcano produced a fresh eruption recorded at 06:10 UTC on November 12, prompting a new Volcanic Ash Advisory and a public health warning from the Philippine Department of Health urging residents near the volcano to protect themselves from ashfall. Alert Level 3 remains in force, indicating a relatively high level of unrest with the possibility of hazardous explosive eruptions and pyroclastic density currents. The DoH advisory reflects concern for respiratory health impacts on communities in Albay Province downwind of the ash plume.

events.title: Wild River Fire Exceeds 50% Containment — Significant Progress Aided by Rain and Crews
events.location: White Mountain National Forest, near Gorham, New Hampshire, USA
events.summary: The Wild River Fire in New Hampshire's White Mountain National Forest has surpassed 50% containment, a major breakthrough for the blaze that grew past 1,000 acres and threatened the Appalachian Trail earlier this week. Wet weather and an unconventional tactic — the use of leaf blowers to clear debris from containment lines — have aided crews significantly in slowing the fire's spread. While the fire remains active, the trajectory is now clearly toward full containment, marking a substantial de-escalation from prior days.

articles.title: Appalachian Trail Threatened by 'Uncommonly' Large Wildfire in White Mountains
